concerns.text: Hard dependency violation: T007c (peak signal matrix) and T043 (delta signal) are marked incomplete and depend on T008 (merged peaks), which is also incomplete. T04_vif_calc depends on T007c. The pipeline cannot proceed to filtering (T04_apply_filters) or modeling (T06_lmm) because the foundational data artifacts (peak_signal_matrix.tsv, delta_peak_signal.tsv) are not produced by any completed task in Phase 2.

Hard dependency violation: T051b (gene filtering) and T04_apply_filters (CRE filtering) are incomplete. T05_weights_impl depends on T04_apply_filters. T06_lmm_impl depends on T05_weights_impl. The critical path for the LMM (US1/US2) is blocked because the filtering tasks required to produce `cre_filtered.tsv` and `filtered_genes.tsv` are not marked as complete or implemented.

Hard dependency violation: T007_sweep_run_lmm depends on T04_apply_filters (incomplete) and T06_lmm_impl (incomplete). T018 (report generation) depends on T007_sweep_calc_overlap, which depends on T007_sweep_run_lmm. The entire User Story 1 implementation chain is broken because upstream filtering and modeling tasks are incomplete.

Hard dependency violation: T04_motif_hic_filter depends on T042 (Hi-C loading) and T008 (merged peaks). T042 is marked incomplete. T008 is incomplete. Consequently, T04_apply_filters (which depends on T04_motif_hic_filter) cannot execute. The Hi-C validation step (FR-014) is a blocking prerequisite for the final CRE set, but its producer task is incomplete.

Hard dependency violation: T07_report_impl depends on T08_visualize_impl, which depends on T018 (incomplete). T018 depends on T007_sweep_run_lmm (incomplete). The final report generation (US2/US3) is blocked by the incomplete US1 implementation chain.

Dependency ambiguity: T007c_narrowpeak_summits depends on T006 (preprocess). T006 is marked complete. However, T007c_narrowpeak_summits is not explicitly linked as a dependency for T08_visualize_impl (which needs summit coordinates), though the description implies it. The dependency chain is clear in text but the task status (incomplete) blocks the consumer.
